source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-10. The table's own CA(110;4,120,2) (Colbourn-Zhou 2012 Theorem 2.2 with Lemma 2.3, type 12^4 10^1, row S7, file table/arrays/CA_110_4_120_2.txt) is kept fixed. One free row and one free column are added and only the new cells are searched by simulated annealing with exact counts on the 4-sets that contain the new column (programs/extt.c, command extt 4 CA_110_4_120_2.txt 110 120 1 1 2 1750 3.0 out, random new cells, 0 uncovered at 303 s; runs at temperatures 2.0 and 1.2 started at the same time had not finished when this one did). Exact check with ca_verify, all 4-sets
construction: Power CZ CA(110;4,120,2) with one row and one column added by annealing, the first 110 rows and 120 columns fixed
notes: ties the cited size 111 at k = 121; no Torres-Jimenez array is an ingredient or start
